open_questions: [IW] initial window: RuntimeConfig default ON (2400 B, runtime.rs:195) contradicts normative engine-spec §3.3-A [K-D2] L300-304 (single-unit PreConverge clamp) and the transport crate's own 'KALİBRE EDİLMEMİŞ' note (sender.rs:315), on n=6/cell evidence. Which is authoritative for v1: amend the spec (D0→D1) or flip the default to 0? Also: the bench kama-product arm defaults to 0 (main.rs:122-124), so every bench cold-start number measures a non-shipping first flight unless --initial-window-bytes 2400 is passed — which configuration is the 'v1 cold-start' under measurement?

DR-EST-1 establish probe is a token-exempt lane (sender.rs:5567-5580) contradicting §3.3-B L332-333 'pacer'ı baypas eden gönderim yolu YOK'; it ships default ON with no RuntimeConfig switch (set_establish_probe is test-only). Spec amendment and/or product knob required?

ACK_FRAME_V2 seen_count/arrival_rate: emitted but never consumed by the sender (K3 consumer pending per spec zeyil L186-187) while TV-COLDSTART-2 (L964) requires direction-discriminated loss from a single SACK. Is the K3 consumer a v1 gate?

PATH_DEAD / cold-start give-up: repo-wide 0 hits; product never gives up in PreConverge (copies ×2 unbounded, establish probe capped at 8 s interval). Is the [K6] single-path no-failover variant (TV-COLDSTART-5) the v1 target, making PATH_DEAD out of scope?

§3.3-B copy schedule: COPY_MAX_INTERVAL cap and deadline-derived RETRY_BUDGET (§12 L876-877) are not implemented (repo-wide grep 0 hits); interval grows ×2 with saturating arithmetic only. Acceptable for v1?

DR-CS-3 receiver side in the product (runtime.rs:2311-2323) is stateless and does not enforce contract receiver §16-18 (≤4 echoes / 172 B per session); only the non-product kama-integration ReceiverControlCore does. If bootstrap_rtt is ever flipped ON, must the product responder gain the budget first? Also server-side RuntimeConfig.bootstrap_rtt is a no-op (bench 'İKİ UÇTA AYNI' is convention only).

Wire codepoints: client-core v0 wire shell uses FRAME_CS_PROBE=0x06 / FRAME_CS_ECHO=0x07 (wire.rs:224-228) while the authoritative noise-wire registry is 0x19/0x1A. Confirm this is covered by the S2 seam swap plan and not a v1 wire mismatch.

Idle→Startup resume: code re-enters Startup (not PreConverge) once an srtt exists (sender.rs:2175-2181), whereas the spec transition table L217 says IDLE --data--> PRE_CONVERGE unconditionally. Amend the table?

§16 TV-COLDSTART golden vectors (L958-968): no tv_coldstart test exists (grep TV-COLDSTART/COLDSTART in crates → 0 hits; tests/cold_start_liveness.rs covers liveness only). Is the golden-vector gate a v1 requirement, and are PRE_CONVERGE_FLOOR_BW / PC_* [CAL PLACEHOLDER] constants (sender.rs:1383, 1453-1458) required to be calibrated before v1?

EK4-A2 next_wakeup_ns is not used by the product runtime (1 ms Pto pump; runtime.rs:6, 61) — cold-start timers (establish probe, ladder) rely on the pump. Acceptable, or must the runtime adopt the exposed-timer contract?
